Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Messier 87

1. After the installation of the COSTAR corrective-optics module in the Hubble Space Telescope in 1993, the Hubble Faint Object Spectrograph (FOS) was used to measure the rotation velocity of the ionized gas disk at the center of M87, as an "early release observation" designed to test the scientific performance of the post-repair Hubble instruments.
2. M87 was observed by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) during much of 2017.
